summary: Pro plan card claims 'Unlimited queries' + features that don't exist (citations, premium model, priority retrieval)
description:
Follow-up to 23153adc. After fixing the Free bullet to source from FREE_DAILY_QUERY_LIMIT, the Pro card was left with marketing copy that doesn't match the product:

  src/app/(app)/account/page.tsx:18
    { id: 'pro', name: 'Pro', price: '\$12/mo',
      features: ['Unlimited queries', 'Premium model',
                 'Citation export', 'Priority retrieval'] }

Truth on each bullet:

  'Unlimited queries' — false. Pro is bounded by PRO_DAILY_USD_CAP
    via the budget reservation. Provider-dependent caps shown on
    /settings: ~27/day DeepSeek, ~9 X.AI, ~3 OpenAI, ~2 Anthropic.
    PRO_DAILY_QUERY_LIMIT (100) is a soft runaway-loop guard, not
    a quota.
  'Premium model'      — vapor. There is no 'premium model' tier;
    Pro means picking among DeepSeek/X.AI/OpenAI/Anthropic. The
    settings page already calls this 'choose how Guru answers'.
  'Citation export'    — vapor. Grep confirms no implementation —
    this string is the only occurrence in the codebase.
  'Priority retrieval' — vapor. Same: no implementation, only
    occurrence is this marketing string.

Fix — replace the four bullets with two that are true:

  features: ['3× more queries per day', 'Choose your provider']

  '3× more queries per day' calibrates against DeepSeek's
  ~27/day vs Free's 10/day (≈ 2.7×, rounded). This is the
  best-case provider; Anthropic at ~2/day is actually LESS
  than Free, but Pro users opt into that tradeoff knowingly
  via the settings picker.

Done when:
  - Pro card on /account shows two bullets only:
    '3× more queries per day' and 'Choose your provider'.
  - No mention of citations, premium model, or priority
    retrieval anywhere in the account page.
  - Existing source-level tests for the page still pass; add
    a guard so the vapor strings can't be reintroduced.
  - tsc + lint + build clean.

Spec: live user feedback after 23153adc shipped on the
chore/pre-launch-cleanup-tickets branch.

resolution.test_function: Pro features include the queries-multiplier and provider-choice bullets
resolution.note: Pro card now lists "3× more queries per day" + "Choose your provider". Vapor bullets removed and locked out by test. 257 tests pass; tsc + lint + build clean.
